claims.claim: You can apply to the Motability Scheme by phone.
claims.note: The helpline is for finding a dealer; the text says the vehicle is ordered at a dealership, not by phone.

claims.claim: Enhanced-rate PIP mobility qualifies for the Motability Scheme.
claims.quote: Enhanced rate mobility part of Personal Independence Payment (PIP)
claims.note: The scheme lists enhanced-rate PIP mobility as qualifying.

claims.claim: At least 12 months must remain on the qualifying award.
claims.quote: You need to have at least 12 months left on your allowance if you're applying to join the Scheme.

claims.claim: At least 12 months must remain on the PIP mobility award when ordering a vehicle.
claims.quote: When you apply for a Motability vehicle, you must have at least 12 months left before your benefit ends
claims.note: Citizens Advice states the 12-month condition when applying for a vehicle.

claims.claim: A PIP award letter confirming enhanced-rate mobility must be supplied.
claims.quote: You can check your award length on your allowance award letter
claims.note: The award letter is mentioned for checking award length, while the required dealer evidence is a certificate of entitlement rather than specifically a PIP award letter.

claims.claim: Evidence must show at least 12 months remain on the award.
claims.quote: You can check your award length on your allowance award letter
claims.note: The 12-month condition and award letter check are stated, but the text does not say this must be supplied as separate evidence.
